name: PCDPA-X2

prototype.age_missing: finite age >0 and <=120; otherwise outer-train valid median; all-missing fallback 17.0
prototype.reference_empty_class: exclude unsupported outer-train queries; never use query's private fold or heldout rows
prototype.site_halves: historical whole-site greedy split for D4 math compatibility; no site crosses halves
prototype.shuffle: condition-shuffle/{site}; outer-train only, within-site joint-age-sex derangement; labels and model inputs unchanged

teacher.reference: same D4 private fold, exclude query self
teacher.empty_support: skip using one common validity mask for N1-N4
teacher.N1: uniform other-reference weights applied to reference onehot(y)
teacher.N2: uniform other-reference weights applied to detached softmax(q_img)
teacher.N3: same-reference age Gaussian times sex kernel applied to detached softmax(q_img)
teacher.N4: N3 kernel with historical same-site joint condition permutation applied to detached softmax(q_img)

native_training: Adam, CE + original graph loss, original validation CE + graph checkpoint selection, original patience, grad-enabled single stochastic test forward
